description:
v1.0 | 327 gates | 4 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Turns a 12-bit binary number into decimal digits (BCD).

Use this in a creation that shows a binary number as ordinary decimal digits, such as a calculator readout. Connect its outputs to seven-segment displays so players can read the value.

Connect the binary number to the input gates, least significant bit first. Each decimal digit comes out as its own group of bits, least significant bit first within the group, with the ones digit first, then the tens and the higher digits.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): the number = x 0-11.
Outputs (green gates): 4 digits of 4 bits, ones digit first, from x 0.

Profile: fast, the build with the fewest ticks for this size.
Design: search.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.

Other sizes, the generator and the full explanation:
